Who changed what, and when: each create, change, delete (to the trash or for good) and restore of the audited entities is kept, in the same transaction as the change, with who made it (a person, a service key, or the system: a command, a job) and each field's value before and after. Each record shows its history, and those who administer see all of it.

```esquadro
blueprint audit
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [domain](../domain/), [postgres](../postgres/), [migrations](../migrations/), [store](../store/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [security](../security/), [jobs](../jobs/), [http](../http/), [rest](../rest/), [client_ts](../client_ts/), [spa](../spa/), [testcontainers](../testcontainers/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entities` | name | `"marked"` | Which entities are audited: marked (those with @audit) or all (but those with @audit(off)). |
| `retention_days` | int | `365` | Days a change is kept, then deleted by a daily job and &lt;app> audit purge; 0 keeps them. |
| `admins` | list | `[]` | Who sees all the changes (GET /audit, the frontends' Audit page), as realm.role rules; empty, those who administer the accounts of the first realm. |
| `history` | name | `"update"` | Who sees a record's history: update (those who may change it), read (those who may read it) or admins. |

```esquadro
blueprint audit {
  entities "marked"
}
```

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| entity | `off` | bool | Not audited, with entities all. |
| field | `secret` | bool | Its changes are kept without its values: only that it changed. |
| field | `ignore` | bool | Its changes are not kept. |

An annotation is written `@audit(key value)` on the element.
